type.families: Neo-grotesque throughout — Inter, Söhne or -apple-system. One family only; weight and size carry every distinction. Numerals must be tabular: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on every figure.
type.hierarchy: Page title 20/28 semibold · section 13/18 semibold · body 13/18 regular · column labels 10/12 semibold ALL-CAPS at 0.08em tracking · figures 13-15 semibold tabular. Nothing above 24px — this style has no display tier.
type.usage: Sentence case for content, ALL-CAPS only for column headers and micro-labels. Never letterspace body copy. Right-align every numeric column, left-align text, and keep the decimal points lined up.

tokens.texture: Effectively none, and that is the point. One flat surface colour, 1px `--line` rules, and a single soft shadow (`0 1px 2px rgb(15 20 25 / .06)`) reserved for elements that genuinely float — menus, popovers, drawers. No gradients, no glass, no glow. Row separation is a border-bottom, never a gap or a card.
tokens.layout: Rules instead of boxes. Tables run full-bleed to the container edge with no outer card. Cell padding 8px 12px — deliberately starved. 4px base scale. Radius 6px on controls, 8px on floating panels, 0 on table cells. Sidebar 216px fixed. Density is the aesthetic: fit more rows before you add whitespace.

best_for: any screen where scanning many rows is the primary job

recipe.medium: flat vector-style UI illustration, technical-diagram sensibility
constraints: near-white background #F4F5F6, white surfaces #FFFFFF
all linework 1px, colour #E3E5E8 — no heavy strokes anywhere
colour restricted to one blue #0B5FD0 plus small semantic marks in green #0A7C4A / red #B42318
flat lighting, absolutely no gradients, glows, bevels or drop shadows
orthogonal composition on a strict grid; everything aligned to a baseline
recipe.negative_space: Reserve the upper-left third as flat #F4F5F6 with no linework, for headline and subhead.

type.families: Neo-grotesque single family (Inter / Söhne / system). Same face at every level.
type.hierarchy: Drawer title 18/24 semibold · card title 14/20 medium · body 13/18 regular · meta 12/16 regular in `--muted` · group headers 11/14 semibold ALL-CAPS 0.06em.
type.usage: Sentence case everywhere except group headers. Capsule labels 11px medium, never uppercase. Keep line length in the detail pane under 68 characters.

tokens.texture: Flat fills with hairline borders. Exactly two elevations: resting cards sit flat with a 1px `--line` border and no shadow; floating layers (drawer, popover, dialog) get `0 12px 32px -8px rgb(11 18 32 / .18)` and sit above a `--scrim` backdrop. Never blur the backdrop — dim it. Column wells use `--well` as a recessed fill, not a border.
tokens.layout: The screen is panels, not pages. Master list left (min 320px), detail right or as a right-docked drawer at 480-560px. Kanban columns are `--well` wells 300px wide holding white cards. 8px base scale, 16px card padding, 12px gap between cards, 10px radius on cards and 8px on controls. The drawer overlays; it never pushes content.

best_for: any app with a list-plus-detail spine
avoid_for: products whose main object is a canvas rather than a list

recipe.medium: flat vector UI illustration with soft depth
constraints: off-white ground #F7F8F9 with white panels #FFFFFF
one violet #5B2FD6 as the only saturated colour
overlapping rectangular panels with 10px rounded corners and 1px #E4E7EC borders
a single soft drop shadow under the frontmost panel only
flat even lighting, no gradients inside panels
recipe.negative_space: Keep the lower third an unbroken #F7F8F9 field for supporting copy.

palette.chip_tints: 10% tint of the semantic hue on white — mint #E7F5EF, lilac #EEEBFB, butter #FBF3E0, blush #FBECEA

type.families: Neo-grotesque or geometric sans (Inter, General Sans, Plus Jakarta). One family; the window chrome is the only place a second is allowed.
type.hierarchy: Window title 16/22 semibold · card title 14/20 semibold · body 13/18 regular · chip 11/14 medium · figure 22/28 semibold. Hero figures may reach 32px inside cards.
type.usage: Sentence case throughout. Status chips carry a 11px medium label on a 10% tint with the full-strength hue as text colour. Never uppercase card titles.

tokens.texture: The window itself is the only elevated object: `0 24px 60px -20px rgb(14 17 19 / .22)` lifting it off the flat stage. Inside, everything is flat with 1px `--line` borders. Optional realistic browser chrome (traffic-light dots, a rounded URL field) frames the app. No gradients inside the UI; the stage stays a single flat grey.
tokens.layout: Compose the shot, not just the screen. A rounded app window (radius 14-16px) floats centred on a flat `--bg` stage with 48-80px of breathing room on every side. Inside: sidebar 232px, content padded 24px, cards 16px padding with 12px radius, 16px gutters. Status colour lives on a card's top strip or left rule so state reads from the grid alone.

best_for: SaaS product marketing where the app is the hero
avoid_for: products with no screen to show

recipe.medium: flat vector UI illustration staged as a product shot
constraints: a single rounded rectangular window floating centred on a flat #ECECEC field
generous empty margin on all four sides of the window
one teal-cyan accent #00849E; everything else white, grey and near-black
one soft wide drop shadow beneath the window, no other shadows
straight-on orthographic view — no perspective tilt
recipe.negative_space: The flat grey margin around the window is the negative space — keep at least 15% of the frame empty on the left.

type.families: Neo-grotesque single family (Inter / Söhne). Numerals tabular in every metric.
type.hierarchy: Modal title 20/28 semibold · metric 28/34 semibold tabular · card title 14/20 semibold · body 13/18 regular · label 11/14 medium in `--muted`.
type.usage: Sentence case. Metrics get the largest optical weight on the screen. Deltas are 12px medium with a directional arrow glyph, coloured `--positive` / `--negative` — these are the only colours allowed to compete with the orange.

tokens.texture: Flat white on flat white, separated by hairlines. Charts are drawn in `--accent` alone: one solid line for the current series, the same hue at 35% opacity for the comparison series. The one licensed exception is a lilac-to-pink gradient strip used exclusively to mark AI-generated content — nothing else in the system may use a gradient. Modals cast `0 20px 48px -12px rgb(21 23 31 / .24)` over a dimmed (never blurred) parent.
tokens.layout: Detail sheets over context. A modal or side sheet at 720-880px floats over the visibly dimmed parent screen, which stays legible so the user keeps their place. 4px scale, 20px sheet padding, 16px card padding, 10px radius. Two-column metric grids inside the sheet; charts get a full-width row of their own.

best_for: any product where one metric family dominates
avoid_for: multi-brand or white-label products needing colour flexibility
calm or clinical medical contexts where orange reads as alarm

recipe.medium: flat vector UI illustration, analytics subject matter
constraints: white ground #FCFCFC with white cards separated by 1px #E6E8EB rules
exactly one saturated hue — burnt orange #D64B00 — carrying every data series and call to action
all other elements in near-black #15171F and greys
flat lighting, no gradients except one optional lilac-pink band
charts rendered as clean 2px strokes, no fills or textures
recipe.negative_space: Leave the top 25% as clean white for a headline; keep charts in the lower two-thirds.

type.families: Neo-grotesque, tightly set (Inter, Helvetica Now, Söhne). Typography does all the work colour normally would, so the family must be good at small sizes.
type.hierarchy: Display 40/44 semibold at -0.03em · section 22/28 medium · body 14/21 regular · micro-caps 10/12 semibold ALL-CAPS at 0.14em tracking. The gap between display and body is deliberately extreme.
type.usage: Tracked-out ALL-CAPS micro-labels are the primary wayfinding device — use them for every section, column and group. Two-tone headlines (first clause in `--ink`, second fading to `--muted`) are the signature move. Never introduce a coloured word.

tokens.texture: Surfaces differ by only a few luminance points — `--bg` against `--surface` is a 3% step, and that step *is* the border. Use shadow sparingly (`0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05)`) and hairlines only where a luminance step would be ambiguous. Absolutely no hue: if a value has saturation, it does not belong.
tokens.layout: Generous and quiet, or dense and quiet — never loud. 8px scale, 24-32px section padding, 12px radius on panels, 999px on pills. The single black pill button is the only high-contrast object on the page and should appear at most twice per screen. Role and status chips are whisper-tints of ink, never colour.

best_for: products that must not compete with user content
collaboration tools where avatars supply the only colour
avoid_for: anything requiring strong brand colour recall

recipe.medium: monochrome studio photography or greyscale 3D render
constraints: strictly greyscale — zero saturation anywhere in the frame
soft even studio lighting with gentle falloff, light grey seamless background
matte surfaces, no gloss or specular hotspots
one subject centred with generous empty space
subtle luminance separation between subject and ground rather than hard edges
negative: text or logos in the image
recipe.negative_space: At least 40% of the frame must be empty light-grey ground.

type.families: Geometric sans with tight tracking (Space Grotesk, General Sans, Aeonik). Headlines set negative at -0.03em.
type.hierarchy: Hero numeral 64/64 light or 72/72 · section 24/30 medium · body 14/21 regular · micro-caps 10/12 medium ALL-CAPS 0.1em. Oversized light-weight numerals are the signature — a metric should be able to fill a third of a card.
type.usage: Let one huge numeral carry the hierarchy per card. Chartreuse never sets type — it sits *behind* type as a highlighter swipe, or fills a pill whose label is `--accent_ink`.

tokens.texture: Flat, with one behaviour that defines the style: chartreuse is applied like a marker, not a fill. Use it as a short swipe behind a word (a skewed rectangle at 0 opacity change), as an underline 6px thick sitting behind the baseline, or as a solid pill. Solid charcoal `--block` cards provide the counterweight. No gradients, no glow — the acid does all the shouting.
tokens.layout: Moderate density with strong blocking. 8px scale, 20-24px card padding, 12-16px radius, occasional pill (999px). Cards alternate between white and solid `--block`. Folder-tab navigation — tabs that visually attach to the panel below — is the characteristic nav pattern. Charts render as open thin-arc gauges rather than filled donuts.

best_for: products targeting a younger technical audience
avoid_for: accessibility-critical products where the accent would be relied on for meaning

recipe.medium: flat vector illustration or matte 3D render with a single fluorescent accent
constraints: desaturated warm-grey ground #EDEFEA
exactly one fluorescent chartreuse #C3EC2E used on no more than 10% of the frame
solid near-black #1C1E18 masses as counterweight
matte surfaces, flat or very soft lighting
geometric shapes with generous rounding
recipe.negative_space: Keep the right 30% as empty desaturated ground for type.

type.families: Geometric sans, light to regular weight only (Aeonik, General Sans, Inter Light). This style never uses bold.
type.hierarchy: Numeral 56/56 light · title 20/26 regular · body 14/21 regular · label 11/14 regular in `--muted`. Weight contrast is deliberately low; size does the separating.
type.usage: Set everything a weight lighter than feels safe. Numerals are large and thin. No uppercase except tiny labels. Tracking stays neutral.

tokens.texture: Borderless fills — cards have no stroke at all, only a subtle fill difference from the ground, plus optional `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)` on translucent controls. The whole composition is presented as a soft-focus 3D render: a matte screen or device sitting in a grey studio with gentle depth-of-field falloff at the frame edges. Shadows are large and very soft (`0 40px 80px -40px rgb(0 0 0 / .35)`).
tokens.layout: Calm, wide and airy. 8px scale, 24px padding, 16-20px radius on every surface, controls fully rounded. Because there are no borders, spacing is the only separator — use 20-24px gaps, never 8px. Content sits in wide low cards rather than tall dense ones.

best_for: anything wanting a calm physical presence

constraints: matte grey studio environment #E2E2E2 with soft gradient falloff
shallow depth of field — subject sharp, background falling gently out of focus
one pale lime accent #DCEE92 on a small element only
soft diffused key light from upper left, no hard shadows
rounded matte geometry, no sharp edges
recipe.negative_space: The defocused background should occupy at least a third of the frame.

type.families: Geometric sans, light and regular (Aeonik, General Sans, Poppins Light). Small sizes, wide spacing.
type.hierarchy: Title 22/28 regular · body 13/20 regular · label 11/15 regular · numeral 32/36 light. Type stays small and calm against the strong geometry.
type.usage: Sentence case, generous letter-spacing on small labels (0.02em). The type never shouts — the black circular controls and pill shapes carry the visual force.

tokens.texture: A fine paper grain over the off-white surfaces is the defining material — a subtle SVG `feTurbulence` at 3-5% opacity, or a repeating noise data-URI. Solid black circular buttons (40-48px) punctuate the layout. The whole UI is presented as a laptop or device render floating in a pure black void, which is why `--bg` is black while every surface is warm off-white.
tokens.layout: Pill-everything. Radius is 999px on inputs, chips, and buttons; 20-24px on cards. 8px scale, 20px card padding. Cards overlap and fan rather than sitting in a strict grid. Colour appears only as tiny status dots or a single hairline highlight — never as a fill larger than a chip.

recipe.medium: studio product photograph on a black set, fine paper grain
constraints: pure black seamless background
warm off-white #F3F1EA subject surfaces with visible fine paper grain
single soft key light from above, gentle falloff into the black
rounded pill and circle geometry
one small fluorescent chartreuse #C9F500 detail, no larger than a coin in frame
recipe.negative_space: At least half the frame is unlit black.

type.families: Geometric sans (Aeonik, General Sans, Satoshi). Headlines set tight at -0.025em; italic is permitted for emphasis inside a headline.
type.hierarchy: Hero 56/60 medium · section 32/38 medium · body 15/24 regular in `--muted` · micro-caps 10/12 medium ALL-CAPS 0.12em with a small bullet dot. Body text is deliberately grey, not white — only headlines get full `--ink`.
type.usage: Sentence case headlines, tracked micro-caps as section eyebrows. Never set long body copy in pure white on black — it vibrates. Cap paragraph width at 62 characters.

tokens.texture: Colour arrives as light, never as fill. Cards are defined by a 1px `rgba(255,255,255,.10)` stroke over an almost invisible 3% white fill — no solid card colours. Behind them, one or two large feathered radial gradients (`radial-gradient(60% 50% at 30% 0%, var(--glow-a) 0%, transparent 70%)`) bleed from an edge or from behind a 3D hero object. Add 2-4% noise over the whole page to stop the gradients banding.
tokens.layout: Modules butted edge to edge with hairline dividers and zero gutters, so the page reads as one continuous dark surface subdivided by light. 8px scale, 28-32px module padding, 14px radius. The hero object (a faceted, iridescent or chrome 3D form) is the only saturated mass; everything else is stroke and glow.

avoid_for: dense working dashboards used all day

recipe.medium: 3D render, iridescent or chrome material, dark studio
constraints: near-black background #08080D with deep falloff
one faceted or organic 3D form as the sole subject, iridescent indigo-to-magenta refraction
light appears as a soft feathered bloom around the object, not as a lamp
subtle film grain across the whole frame
no ground plane — the object floats in void
negative: text or UI in the image
recipe.negative_space: The lower 40% falls to near-black for text overlay.
